summary: The preprint reports 82 hypothalamic genes at adjusted P < 0.1 but does not identify the genes or mice behind that count. It uses a weaning-weight cutoff of >13.5 g, while GEO defines high weight as >14 g. The cited supplement could not be located, and inspection of all 87 GEO sample files and the normalized matrix found no gene-level contrast results to compare. [Preprint, printed page 16](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2024.01.29.577705v1.full.pdf)
openIssues: Did the authors compare GSM7509651–GSM7509654 against GSM7509661–GSM7509664, high minus low glucose? Which exclusions, model and coefficient produced the 82 calls, and where are the cited supplement and tested-gene table with signed effects, raw P and adjusted P?
